name: Finance Payment Request
description: One external payment request linked to a safe Stripe invoice reference, with deterministic mutation recovery and separate owner-approved finalization and send gates.
audience: Solo entrepreneurs issuing a reviewed Stripe invoice from an external payment-request record
problem: Sending an invoice is repetitive, but a draft, finalization, customer delivery, recovery, and external records must remain distinguishable.
outcome: One external payment request linked to a safe Stripe invoice reference, with deterministic mutation recovery and separate owner-approved finalization and send gates.
whyAi: An agent can prepare a bounded Stripe invoice from the selected external record while enforcing idempotency, separating draft work from customer delivery, and preserving owner decisions.
operatorPath: Request an invoice from the external billing record; the agent resolves workspace defaults and prepares the draft.
Review the exact draft once and approve its finalization and initial send together if desired; the agent records that decision against both technical gates.
Inspect a safe provider result, exception, or recovery recommendation; never provide customer data or payment instructions in chat.
agentPath: Preflight one external payment request and resolve only safe account-bound Stripe references.
Create/reconcile a draft customer, invoice, and invoice item with deterministic idempotency keys.
Use action-level owner approvals for finalize and send; a standing policy is guidance and cannot waive either technical gate.
Write safe provider/status/proof refs back to the selected external backend and hand open invoices to follow-up work when appropriate.
recovery: For an unknown write outcome, retrieve/reconcile the same safe provider refs with the same deterministic key; never create a new key or duplicate customer/invoice/item.
If approval is absent, stop at the review-ready draft and do not finalize or send.
safeStoppingPoints: Stop with a draft/reconciliation recommendation before finalization when approval is not recorded.
Stop after finalization but before send when the send gate is absent or delivery outcome is uncertain.

handoffs.when: A safely recorded sent/open invoice is eligible for follow-up policy evaluation.
Safe invoice lifecycle evidence must be prepared/matched in the external backend.

prerequisites: A restricted Stripe connection with the invoice route selected
A selected workspace and one billing-request reference resolving an immutable external version with customer, lines, currency and terms
Owner approval of the concrete draft before finalization and send; these approvals are produced during the run
proof: Safe external payment-request and Stripe invoice/customer refs
Action-call/provider request refs, idempotency/reconciliation status, and owner approval refs
External backend write proof and workflow handoff refs
whenToUse: A single approved external payment request needs a Stripe draft invoice, finalization, and customer delivery.

stages.title: Preflight External Request And Stripe Route
stages.summary: Resolve one immutable billing request and workspace billing/customer-mapping rules.

stages.title: Resolve Or Create Customer
stages.summary: Reconcile an approved external customer to a safe account-bound Stripe customer ref.

stages.title: Create Or Reconcile Draft Invoice
stages.summary: Prepare the approved external request as a Stripe draft invoice and item without finalizing or sending.

stages.title: Review Draft And Required Owner Gates
stages.summary: Confirm external request consistency and make finalization/send approvals available to their exact action contracts.

stages.title: Finalize Approved Invoice
stages.summary: Run only the owner-approved Stripe finalization action and reconcile unknown outcomes with reads.

stages.title: Send Approved Invoice
stages.summary: Run only the owner-approved Stripe customer send action and reconcile unknown outcomes with reads.

stages.title: Record External Status And Handoff
stages.summary: Record safe Stripe outcome refs in the selected external backend and hand eligible open invoices to follow-up work.
